text:
Sarah K.: Hey team — got an invoice from Quasar Dataworks (INV-2026-314) but our AP system rejected it. Vendor put tax on top of a PO line item and the PO number on the invoice (PO-88421) is for the old cost center. Can someone help route/approve?
Mike C.: Ack, I see the rejection: "PO mismatch / tax allocation not allowed". Finance needs a PO that includes tax lines or we need a memo from procurement.
Raj P.: FYI PO-88421 was reclassified last week to COST-ENG-3 when we moved projects. The PO still exists but the approver routing changed to Julia W. — maybe AP can't find the approver because of the cost center change.
Sarah K.: That makes sense. AP Bot shows: "Invoice missing matching PO line for tax amount". Can procurement either update the PO to include tax or confirm a secondary approval?
Julia W.: I can approve but need a quick note from Raj confirming spend is valid under the reclassified cost center. If AP needs the PO updated, I can trigger Procure UI but that requires the old PO to be reopened.
Raj P.: I can confirm. Confirming here: Quasar Dataworks work for Q1 latency tests is valid under COST-ENG-3 and the tax is legitimate. @Julia W. please approve.
AP Bot: "Invoice INV-2026-314: held — awaiting approver confirmation or PO amendment. Add comment or attach supporting doc to release."
procure-bot: "PO-88421 status: closed -> reopen_requested by Julia W. ETA 2 business days if change approved."
Mike C.: Quick doc attached? Sarah, can you upload the vendor statement and Raj's note to the AP ticket? That should unblock. Also flag for next month: procurement should include tax handling in the PO template. :clipboard:
Sarah K.: Uploaded vendor statement and pasted Raj's confirmation into the ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian/FIN-3421). @Julia W. can you hit approve on the AP ticket when you have a sec?
Julia W.: Approved in AP system. Also requested reopen on PO. procure-bot confirmed reopen requested.
AP Bot: "Invoice INV-2026-314: approval recorded by Julia W. — processing for payment. Expected payment run next Tue."
Sarah K.: Thanks all — closing ticket after payment posts. Filing note: add PO tax allowance to procurement checklist. :white_check_mark:
